_readme: Case studies matched to a prospect, for the Lead List modal. DealForge picks these: market axis matches on industries + buyer titles, offer axis matches on offer type. In production this is GET /api/jobs/:id/case-study-matches. Narrative is written prose, not a template — a rep reads it aloud on the call.

matches.serves: COOs and CEOs at manufacturing and industrial companies
matches.narrative: Joshua Hollander runs a global executive search firm. Like you, he sells to COOs and CEOs at manufacturing and industrial companies — the same people on your list, in the same industries.
matches.tam_line: His addressable market came out at 310,000. Yours is 214,000. Close enough that his numbers are a fair read on what yours could look like.
matches.result: He sent 30,232 invites for a single webinar. 387 people registered, 129 turned up live. He ran nine at that volume between October and February.
matches.source: QS Client Results Database, Oct 2024 – Feb 2025

matches.serves: agency owners stuck at the $1.3M / $3M / $7M plateaus
matches.narrative: Juliana Marulanda sells operations consulting, same as you. She just sells it to agency owners rather than industrial operators — a diagnostic, then a twelve-week implementation, which is close to how you work.
matches.result: From one webinar: 8,334 invites, 233 registrations, and five booked calls.
